coordinates.origin: Tube/body lowest point atZ0, forward-Y; scene can bury or tilt instance without baking sediment.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: Original muted natural palette; color artistic, not copied fossil mineral stains or reference pixels.

view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect cheap clay views for morphology, silhouette and attachment before final exactGLB four views.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB. Perspective and preview may reuse identical bytes.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a local view only for a specific unresolved issue.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website renderer/camera configuration has not been verified during prep. Keep canonical QA directions, do not claim website compatibility, and do not produce 768x432 derivatives here.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

acceptance_obligations: Distinct animal silhouette and anatomical brief compliance in four exact-GLB views.
Portable embedded GLB, source reopening and scoped technical checks; independent review separate.
Mark GPU, world scene, user acceptance and deployment unverified until actually checked.
scope: Original static complete animal for a Cambrian marine region in a prehistoric3Dworld. No rig, animation or game-ready integration claim.

scientific_limits.en: Soft tissue inflation, deployed introvert posture, spine simplification and color are interpretive. Do not claim precise spine counts or mineralized tube. Preserve hidden continuous trunk but no elaborate internal gut.

anatomical_anchors: USNM57624 holotype, published specimen length31mm; USNM83941a51mm. Selected45mm illustrative adult lies below reported60mm maximum, not measured individual.

scale.basis: USNM57624 holotype, published specimen length31mm; USNM83941a51mm. Selected45mm illustrative adult lies below reported60mm maximum, not measured individual.

pose.description: Whole animal plus own tube, gentle horizontal resting pose with introvert extended at wide anterior aperture. Do not include substrate.

morphology.obligation: Slightly tapered organic tube open at BOTH ends, fine transverse annulations, not a mineral shell or closed cone.
Continuous worm trunk inside tube with protruding radially symmetrical spinose introvert; a readable open mouth rather than a flower or tentacled anemone.
Small anterior trunk papillae; no arthropod legs, eyes or invented long tentacles.

concept.reason: Actual fossil image pixels and museum anatomical description inspected; original form construction not copied reference mesh.

geometry_budget_rationale: Ceilings only, not density targets. Spend geometry on diagnostic anatomy and continuous attachments; no hidden microdetail.

art_direction.construction: Original coherent lofts, controlled tapered appendages and readable negative space; no floating parts or mechanically stacked primitives.

world_use.placement: Independent animal asset. Do not bake seabed or normalize scale; use scene closeups, not permanently enlarged source geometry. Exact community coexistence requires locality/age match.
world_use.integration_boundary: Static output; rigs, collision,LOD and scene behavior not promised.
